title: Oil Surges Above $105, Arnott Warns of Bubble Risk
description:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Oil above $105. Stocks and Treasuries sinking as rate-hike bets build.  Plus, housing hits a fresh slowdown, Macy’s disappoints, and Rob Arnott warns markets look frothy. And Joe Kaiser joins us on the next phase of the AI boom where power may become the biggest constraint.
